# Beauty by Kyrin: Full Business Profile

## Business overview

Beauty by Kyrin is an independent Las Vegas hair stylist business owned by Kyrin Weidauer. Kyrin works inside Venus Salon at 8665 W Flamingo Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89147. The business specializes in custom cuts, dimensional color, balayage, highlights, extensions, blowouts, and hair treatments.

Kyrin uses a consultation-first approach. Each appointment begins with a conversation about the client's goals, hair history, natural texture, and routine. Recommendations are tailored to the client's starting point and desired maintenance level.

## Services

### Cuts and styling

Precision cuts for straight, wavy, curly, and coily hair, tailored to face shape, texture, and daily routine. Services may include bobs, layers, curtain bangs, shags, classic trims, and a finished style.

### Color and highlights

Full color, partial highlights, full highlights, and dimensional color using professional formulas selected for the client's starting point and goals.

### Balayage

Hand-painted brightness designed for a soft blend and natural grow-out. Balayage is suited to clients seeking lived-in dimension and lower-maintenance lightness.

### Extensions

Extension options may include tape-in, weft, and hand-tied methods using human hair. The method, quantity, length, and color match are selected during consultation.

### Blowouts

Professional blowout styling for a smooth, polished finish, with optional waves or curls.

### Treatments

Available treatment categories include keratin services, deep conditioning, and scalp care. Treatment recommendations depend on the client's hair and scalp needs.

## Location and service area

Beauty by Kyrin is located inside Venus Salon at 8665 W Flamingo Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89147. The business serves Las Vegas and nearby communities including Henderson, North Las Vegas, Summerlin, Spring Valley, and Enterprise.
